correctness.rationale: Exact first-feasible-edge conditioning gives P_G(z)=z/|E(G)| sum_{uv in E(G)}P_{G-{u,v}}(z), with edgeless base P=1, so all computed coefficients are exact rational probabilities. A complete unlabeled-tree enumeration checks the 987 types of orders <=12 and 1301 at order 13; after dividing off z^m the degrees are <=3 and rational quadratic/cubic discriminants certify every root claim. Six exceptions are exactly enumerated and encoded. The symmetric witness has cubic factor 180+1852z+5149z²+4339z³, discriminant -12323232144. A separate all-12!-edge-permutation integer-state DP reproduces its four exact coefficients. The packaged runnable checker was executed successfully.

value.rationale: Real-rootedness implies strong distributional constraints (and, after normalizing the zero factors, Poisson-binomial factorization for nonnegative coefficients). The class of random greedy matching terminal laws is a natural stochastic object, with the famous matching polynomial inviting an incorrect analogy. The exact minimal failure size and complete six-isomorphism-type boundary provide useful sharp structural information. The witness remains strictly log-concave, distinguishing non-real-rootedness from a trivial coefficient pathology. No unproved extension beyond thirteen vertices is presented.
